name: Hozjain smerti
source:
Friendship gave you hope. Then the darkness took hold of your loved ones – and left you trapped in a nightmare you never saw coming.

[From [url=https://asreal7.itch.io/master-of-death]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
友谊给了你希望。然后黑暗抓住了你所爱的人，让你陷入了一场你从未预见到的噩梦中。

[来自[url=https://asreal7.itch.io/master-of-death]Itch.io[/url]]
